## Jadwal Semester

::: {.callout-note}
Jadwal di bawah adalah jadwal resmi Semester Gasal 2026/2027. Tautan ke
halaman Materi/Tutorial/Tugas akan ditambahkan begitu konten masing-masing
minggu selesai ditulis ulang menyesuaikan topik & urutan baru ini.
:::

### Topik, Tutorial & Assignment Mingguan

Kelas tatap muka berlangsung **Senin (Sesi 1) & Rabu (Sesi 2)** setiap
minggu. Tidak ada lagi Tugas Individu mingguan — penilaian individu berupa
**Kuis** di minggu tertentu dan beberapa **Tutorial Asynchronous**
(dikerjakan mandiri, tanpa sesi lab).

| Minggu | Kelas | Sesi 1 (Senin) | Sesi 2 (Rabu) | Assignment |
|:---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 24 & 26 Ags | **Topik 01:** Introduction to Platform-Based Programming, Internet & Framework | **Topik 02:** AI-Assisted Platform-Based Programming | Tutorial Asynchronous: Setup Git Repository, Django Initial Project |
| 2 | 31 Ags & 2 Sep | **Topik 03:** Web Design Using HTML5 dan CSS3 | **Tutorial 01:** Setup Git Repository, Django Initial Project, HTML5 dan CSS3 | — |
| 3 | 7 & 9 Sep | **Topik 04:** MTV Django Architecture | **Tutorial 02:** Aplikasi Django dan Model-View-Template (MVT) | — |
| 4 | 14 & 16 Sep | **Topik 05:** Data Delivery | **Tutorial 03:** Form dan Data Delivery | — |
| 5 | 21 & 23 Sep | **Topik 06:** Form, Authentication, Session, and Cookie | **Tutorial 04:** Autentikasi, Session, Cookies | Kuis 1 |
| 6 | 28 & 30 Sep | **Topik 07:** Web Interactivity + Server-Sent Event | **Tutorial 05:** JavaScript dan AJAX | — |
| 7 | 5 & 7 Okt | **Topik 08:** More on Web Development (Cache Control, HTMX) | **Tutorial 06:** HTMX, Pengayaan DevTools (Inspect, Lighthouse) | Kuis 2 |
| 8 | 12 & 14 Okt | **UTS** | — | — |
| 9 | 19 & 21 Okt | Proyek Tengah Semester | Proyek Tengah Semester | Offline Demo dengan Asdos |
| 10 | 26 & 28 Okt | **Topik 09:** Django REST Framework | **Tutorial 07:** DRF | — |
| 11 | 2 & 4 Nov | **Topik 10:** Intro to Dart Programming & Flutter | **Tutorial 08:** Pengantar Flutter | Tutorial Asynchronous: Flutter Deployment dengan GitHub Actions dan Bitrise |
| 12 | 9 & 11 Nov | **Topik 11:** Layouts & Forms | **Tutorial 09:** Flutter Navigation, Layouts, Forms, and Input Elements | — |
| 13 | 16 & 18 Nov | **Topik 12:** Navigation, Networking and Integration | **Tutorial 10:** Flutter Networking, Authentication, and Integration | Kuis 3 |
| 14 | 23 & 25 Nov | Proyek Akhir Semester | Proyek Akhir Semester | — |
| 15 | 30 Nov & 2 Des | Proyek Akhir Semester | Proyek Akhir Semester | Offline Demo dengan Asdos |
| 16 | 7 & 9 Des | **UAS** | — | — |

## Semester Schedule

::: {.callout-note}
The schedule below is the official Odd Semester 2026/2027 schedule. Links
to the Materials/Tutorial/Assignment pages will be added once each week's
content has been rewritten to match this new topic order.
:::

### Weekly Topics, Tutorials & Assignments

In-person classes run **Monday (Session 1) & Wednesday (Session 2)** every
week. There are no more weekly Individual Assignments — individual
assessment is via **Quizzes** on certain weeks and a couple of
**Asynchronous Tutorials** (done independently, no lab session).

| Week | Class | Session 1 (Mon) | Session 2 (Wed) | Assignment |
|:---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 24 & 26 Aug | **Topic 01:** Introduction to Platform-Based Programming, Internet & Framework | **Topic 02:** AI-Assisted Platform-Based Programming | Asynchronous Tutorial: Set Up Git Repository, Django Initial Project |
| 2 | 31 Aug & 2 Sep | **Topic 03:** Web Design Using HTML5 and CSS3 | **Tutorial 01:** Set Up Git Repository, Django Initial Project, HTML5 and CSS3 | — |
| 3 | 7 & 9 Sep | **Topic 04:** MTV Django Architecture | **Tutorial 02:** Django Application and Model-View-Template (MVT) | — |
| 4 | 14 & 16 Sep | **Topic 05:** Data Delivery | **Tutorial 03:** Forms and Data Delivery | — |
| 5 | 21 & 23 Sep | **Topic 06:** Form, Authentication, Session, and Cookie | **Tutorial 04:** Authentication, Sessions, Cookies | Quiz 1 |
| 6 | 28 & 30 Sep | **Topic 07:** Web Interactivity + Server-Sent Events | **Tutorial 05:** JavaScript and AJAX | — |
| 7 | 5 & 7 Oct | **Topic 08:** More on Web Development (Cache Control, HTMX) | **Tutorial 06:** HTMX, DevTools Deep-Dive (Inspect, Lighthouse) | Quiz 2 |
| 8 | 12 & 14 Oct | **Midterm Exam** | — | — |
| 9 | 19 & 21 Oct | Midterm Group Project | Midterm Group Project | Offline Demo with TAs |
| 10 | 26 & 28 Oct | **Topic 09:** Django REST Framework | **Tutorial 07:** DRF | — |
| 11 | 2 & 4 Nov | **Topic 10:** Intro to Dart Programming & Flutter | **Tutorial 08:** Introduction to Flutter | Asynchronous Tutorial: Flutter Deployment with GitHub Actions and Bitrise |
| 12 | 9 & 11 Nov | **Topic 11:** Layouts & Forms | **Tutorial 09:** Flutter Navigation, Layouts, Forms, and Input Elements | — |
| 13 | 16 & 18 Nov | **Topic 12:** Navigation, Networking and Integration | **Tutorial 10:** Flutter Networking, Authentication, and Integration | Quiz 3 |
| 14 | 23 & 25 Nov | Final Group Project | Final Group Project | — |
| 15 | 30 Nov & 2 Dec | Final Group Project | Final Group Project | Offline Demo with TAs |
| 16 | 7 & 9 Dec | **Final Exam** | — | — |

: {tbl-colwidths="[7,13,28,28,24]"}
